spans.text: Redact secrets: never store tokens/keys/passwords; replace with [REDACTED_SECRET].
spans.note: The prompt explicitly requires redaction of secrets, tokens, keys, and passwords. It treats sensitive data protection as a strict global rule and instructs the agent to never store credentials.

spans.text: Raw rollouts are immutable evidence. NEVER edit raw rollouts.

spans.text: Optimize for future user time saved, not just future agent time saved.
spans.note: The prompt is designed to preserve user agency by prioritizing user messages over assistant messages, treating user corrections and interruptions as high-signal preference evidence, and ensuring future agents anticipate user needs without overriding user control. The system explicitly values reducing user keystrokes and corrections.
